channel.title: Felix Krusch - Insights
channel.description: First-hand notes on design, development, and building things that work.

item.title: How Long Does It Take to Get a Website Designed?
item.description: About ten working days if the assets are ready. Longer if they aren't. Agencies quote weeks because of handoffs, not because the work is harder.

item.title: What Questions Should You Ask Before Hiring a Web Designer?
item.description: 28 essential questions to ask before hiring a web designer. Protect yourself from project disasters, scope creep, and bad platform choices. From someone who's seen it all.

item.title: How Much Does It Cost to Hire a Web Designer?
item.description: Honest breakdown of web design costs: from 500 EUR offshore freelancers to 25000 EUR agencies. My pricing as a specialist freelancer, what you get, and why the market works this way.

item.title: Should I Hire a Web Designer or Use a DIY Website Builder?
item.description: DIY website builders look cheap, until you count the real cost in time, lost leads and brand damage. Honest comparison from a web designer with 28 years of experience and 300+ projects.

item.title: Agility and Pivots
item.description: I never planned to specialize. I just got really good at one thing because that was how I lived. Over time it became my sharp spike.

item.title: Agents Are the New CMS
item.description: 2026: Your website shouldn't fight you every time you want to update it. AI agents sitting between you and the site so you never have to touch the backend again.

item.title: WordPress FSE diminishing returns
item.description: WordPress FSE is a lesson in diminishing returns. The complexity-to-flexibility ratio doesn't make sense when modern stacks just work.

item.title: Why 85% of Cleaning Companies & Janitor Websites Scare Off Customers in 2026
item.description: The hard truth: Slow loading times, unclear prices, missing forms, fake images, no reviews, mobile issues. A simple one-pager fixes 80% and brings more inquiries. No agency needed.

item.title: Freelancers Obliterate Agencies for SMEs in 2026 - Wake Up
item.description: Small/midsize businesses are getting robbed by agencies charging 3-4x more for the same work. Freelancers deliver 90-110% quality for 30-60% of the price with faster delivery.

item.title: Noise drowns signal, people tune out
item.description: If the platform's filtering cannot surface scarce human signal effectively, noise drowns signal and people tune out. But when filtering works well, genuine personal content becomes disproportionately valuable.

item.title: You don't need a CMS anymore
item.description: Not for blogs, not for small e-commerce, not for company sites. Security concerns, page builder drag, wasted time. Write in one language, polish automatically, translate . Serve clean and fast.
